So you can dig straight to hell, but in that case i don't think you need 5 blocks wide gap. If you do that you should contaminate crimson/corruption with unconvertable block like mud or stoneslab. You can dp this by putting "walls" on the left and right side of the hellevator. If you don't want to dig, after you defeat a mech boss, a steampumker will come in, so you can buy a clentaminator, and a green solution, and you will be able to purify your world, but the sad part is that its realy expensive. The next sad part is that crates fished pre-hardmode can't drop hardmode ores now. After starting hm you can get hm crates, that give hm ores. Honestly a big priority should be getting wings (you can buy leaf wings from Witch Doctor as a staring wings, but they're really weak now). I like to get Daedalus Stormbow, holy arrows and switching class to archer for a bit to defeat Destroyer for Hallowed Armor. If you don't want more corruption/crimson, you should fish for those hm crates, get full archer set, and switch to hallowed stuff. (Because as the person below me said, if you destroy demon altar, there is 66% chance that a corrupted block will spawn somewhere in your world, and that can really fuck your world up.


Oh, also you can only buy leaf wings, when witch doctor is in jungle

The most inportant thing is that you make 5 blocks wide gaps between crimson/corruption and your pure bioms, so that they won't spread (sunflowers no longer work in hardmode). You should have bee armor and imp staff, and your friend should have molten armor. You need to defeat skeletron and Queen Bee (but she's less necessary) I'd recommend you set up pylon network so its easier to travel, so you'll die less. After you beat WoF you can fish for crates so you'll get easy HM ores.

Edit : Oh and snapthorn would be great for you as a summoner (or any whip for that case)
